correctness.rationale: Exact conditional binomial transition gives affine regression and conditional variance. Exact stationary first/second moments yield uniform O(n) stationary variance and limit v_c=c(c+2)/(2(1+c)^3). At p=c/n, conditional variance converges to H_c=c(c+2)/(1+c)^2; jumps have uniformly bounded fourth moments via binomial domination. The stationarity moment bound, martingale functional CLT, semimartingale tightness and uniqueness of the stationary OU limit prove the entire functional theorem. The standalone standard-library checker independently passes 945 exact-rational identities across n=2..8 and three rational p values. Mathematical boundaries and unproved cases are explicit.

value.rationale: The natural critical loss regime p=c/n is already central to the source model’s metastable behavior. The finding quantifies typical equilibrium fluctuations at the sharp sqrt(n) scale and their n-step correlation time, replacing a misleading independent-coupon variance by the exact reduction factor (c+2)/(2(1+c)). This is a model-specific structural law for cache/sensor freshness despite existing first-order concentration and rare-event hitting results; it does not require a new completion-time theorem to be mathematically useful.
